claims.statement: For every strictly increasing psi:R->R and every strictly increasing F_tilde:R->[0,1], there exists a strictly proper binary loss (l0,l1) with psi(z)=l0(F_tilde(z)) for every z in R.
claims.acceptance: A machine-checkable proof certificate for the constructive loss on the full stated domain, or an assumption-satisfying counterexample.

claims.statement: If R is the regret of a proper loss on Delta_n, then R(p||q) equals the Bregman divergence generated by phi(p)=-L(p,p), with a subgradient selection G_i=-ell_i.
claims.acceptance: An independently reconstructed symbolic derivation checking the subgradient and regret identities for arbitrary symbolic p,q, plus controls that violate properness.

claims.statement: KLST* is exactly expandability plus a local choice structure for every alpha in (0,1) plus monotonicity for at least one alpha in (0,1), for every context x; it permits abstention through nonedges of the zero-abstention graph.
claims.acceptance: Exact rational construction satisfying every axiom and exhibiting nonzero abstention, with exhaustive checking over its complete finite alternative domain and symbolic-in-alpha checks for lotteries.

claims.statement: Every KLST* choice probability admits p(y>y'|x)=F(u(x,y)-u(x,y')) for a strictly increasing F with image in [0,1] and F(-z)+F(z)<=1 on dom(F).
claims.acceptance: A proof-level reduction with all KLST* obligations checked, or a complete finite-domain assumption-satisfying counterexample search certificate.

claims.statement: For a strictly proper binary loss, H=l0-l1 is a subgradient of phi=-L(p,p), phi*(z)=l0(H^-1(z)), and symmetry gives l1(H^-1(z))=phi*(-z); DPO is the log-loss/sigmoid/logistic special case of the triptych.
quantifiers: forall z in the canonical-link image
claims.acceptance: Symbolic proof certificates for the general identities and exact derivation of the log-loss/sigmoid/logistic specialization over its full domain, with asymmetric and sign-error controls.
